name: Hardened brigandine gloves
description: Heavy canvas gloves with small plates of hardened steel riveted over the back of the hand and down each finger. Stiff in the fingers, but a blade skids off them.
notes: Laid side by side, back up, thumbs inward: each glove is 240 mm from cuff to fingertip, canvas with a curved steel plate over the back of the hand, two plates down each finger and the thumb, and a buckled cuff strap. The model's box is the pair laid out flat. Slot `hands` follows batch 109's tempered gloves: no earlier slot covers the hands. Rides on batch 109's `tempered_brigandine_gloves` model with plates and rivets in `steel-hardened`. Size variants share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened elbow guards
description: A pair of small domed elbow cups of hardened steel, each with a side wing and two leather straps. Light enough to wear over vambraces or mail.
notes: Laid side by side, convex side up: each guard is a domed steel cup over the joint with a curved lame above and below it, a round wing on the outer side and two buckled leather straps behind, 150 mm from top to foot. Slot `elbows` follows batch 109's tempered elbow guards: `arms` is taken by vambraces and arm guards, which elbow guards are worn over. Rides on batch 109's `tempered_elbow_guards` model with plates and rivets in `steel-hardened`. Size variants share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened splint greaves
description: Canvas shin guards lined with strips of hardened steel and closed with three buckled straps. They cover the leg from knee to ankle and fit over mail.
notes: Laid side by side, open side down: each greave is a canvas shell curved across the shin, 380 mm from knee to ankle and 160 mm across at the calf, with six steel splints riveted along it, leather binding at both ends and three buckled straps. The model's box is the pair laid out flat with their straps spread. Slot `shins` follows batch 109's tempered greaves: `legs` is taken by trousers, which greaves are worn over. Rides on batch 109's `tempered_splint_greaves` model with splints and rivets in `steel-hardened`. Size variants share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened knee guards
description: A pair of thin domed knee cups of hardened steel, with a small wing to cover the side of the joint. They strap on over greaves or mail.
notes: Laid side by side, convex side up: each guard is a domed steel cup over the joint with a curved lame above and below it, a round wing on the outer side and two buckled leather straps behind, 200 mm from top to foot and 190 mm across the wing. The model's box is the pair laid out flat with their straps spread. Slot `knees` follows batch 109's knee guards: `legs` is taken by trousers, and knee guards are worn over greaves. Rides on batch 109's `medium_steel_knee_guards` model with plates and rivets in `steel-hardened`. Size variants share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Hardened shoulder guards
description: A pair of overlapping hardened steel shoulder plates with leather points at the collar, made to be laced onto a brigandine.
notes: Laid side by side, convex side up: each guard is a cap plate and three overlapping riveted lames running down the arm, 190 mm from collar to arm and 175 mm across, with two leather lacing points at the collar. The model's box is the pair laid out flat. Worn by mounting on a brigandine's shoulder points, so it `fits` `brigandine` and its `wearable` has no slot. Protection and wear follow the hardened steel vambraces. Rides on batch 109's `medium_steel_shoulder_guards` model with plates and rivets in `steel-hardened`. Size variants share the model.
